label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is the concatenation of literals and bar (which holds decoded user input) printed directly to response.getWriter() without HTML encoding. The codeFlow shows bar flows from request.getHeader() -> decode() -> map lookup -> return, meaning attacker-controlled data reaches the XSS sink. Alert 2 (java/sql-injection): alert-TP — resolved sink value is bar concatenated directly into the SQL query string without sanitization, allowing injection. Both alerts represent real vulnerabilities on their respective paths.

evidence.note: User input flows from getHeader through decode and into bar variable which is used in both sinks.
XSS sink: bar is concatenated into response output without encoding.
SQL injection sink: bar is concatenated directly into SQL query string.
